# Command line

nbpdns writes each command's output to standard output, and its logs and errors
to standard error. Every command accepts `--help`. nbpdns exits with one of
these statuses:

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The command succeeded. |
| 1 | The command failed. Standard error says why. |
| 2 | The command line was wrong: an unknown command or flag, or a bad argument. |

## Global flags

Every command accepts these flags. Each sets a configuration key, as described
in the [configuration reference](configuration.md).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | `string` | none | The YAML config file to read, instead of `$NBPDNS_CONFIG`. |
| `--log-format` | `string` | `json` | How log lines are written to standard error. |
| `--log-level` | `string` | `info` | The lowest level of log message to write. |
| `--netbox-ca-file` | `path` | none | A PEM file of CA certificates to trust for NetBox, as well as the system's. |
| `--netbox-concurrency` | `integer` | `4` | How many requests to NetBox may be in flight at once. |
| `--netbox-page-size` | `integer` | `500` | How many objects to ask NetBox for in each page of a list. |
| `--netbox-timeout` | `duration` | `30s` | How long one request to NetBox may take. |
| `--netbox-token` | `string` | none | The NetBox API token that nbpdns reads with. |
| `--netbox-token-file` | `path` | none | Read `netbox.token` from this file. |
| `--netbox-url` | `url` | none | NetBox's base URL, such as `https://netbox.example.com`. |

## Commands

### `nbpdns completion`

Print a script that completes nbpdns's commands and flags in bash, zsh,
fish, or PowerShell. Each shell's subcommand explains how to load its script.

```text
nbpdns completion [command]
```

Subcommands: [`bash`](#nbpdns-completion-bash), [`fish`](#nbpdns-completion-fish), [`powershell`](#nbpdns-completion-powershell), and [`zsh`](#nbpdns-completion-zsh).

### `nbpdns completion bash`

Print the completion script for bash.

```text
nbpdns completion bash
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--no-descriptions` | `bool` | none | Leave out the descriptions of commands and flags. |

### `nbpdns completion fish`

Print the completion script for fish.

```text
nbpdns completion fish [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--no-descriptions` | `bool` | none | Leave out the descriptions of commands and flags. |

### `nbpdns completion powershell`

Print the completion script for PowerShell.

```text
nbpdns completion powershell [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--no-descriptions` | `bool` | none | Leave out the descriptions of commands and flags. |

### `nbpdns completion zsh`

Print the completion script for zsh.

```text
nbpdns completion zsh [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--no-descriptions` | `bool` | none | Leave out the descriptions of commands and flags. |

### `nbpdns config`

Inspect nbpdns's configuration.

```text
nbpdns config [command]
```

Subcommands: [`show`](#nbpdns-config-show).

### `nbpdns config show`

Show each configuration key's effective value, and the flag, environment
variable, config file, or default it came from. Secrets show as [redacted].

If any setting is invalid, nbpdns lists every problem and exits with status 1.

```text
nbpdns config show [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-o`, `--output` | `format` | `table` | The output format: `table` or `json`. |

### `nbpdns version`

Print the version, commit, and Go version that nbpdns was built with.

```text
nbpdns version [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-o`, `--output` | `format` | `table` | The output format: `table` or `json`. |
